protocol_amendment.timing: After path/fold helper code; before any H58 model fit, holdout score or output.
protocol_amendment.reason: Clarify prevalence matching as 0.2% of each fold's scored region, so hide and block folds target the same local prevalence rather than assigning each quadrant the full-map truth count.

additional_pre_score_clarification.timing: During code review, before any H58 model fit, holdout score or output.
additional_pre_score_clarification.reason: Require both positive and negative training pixels to be within fit; construct negative clearance only from labels visible in fit; quarantine whole components that cross into a block's scored quadrant but are majority-assigned elsewhere, without adding them to truth; evaluate pseudo-label AUC on primary-held components versus catalogue-zero proxy negatives outside the 500 m full-catalogue clearance in the edge-cleared scored region, rather than removing the evaluation region with the training collar.

data_integrity.required_action: Verify input bytes and SHA-256 against the manifest before every run; fail closed on mismatch.
data_integrity.qualification: The exact pins are owner-supplied mirrors. A matching manifest verifies mirror integrity, not organizer provenance.
data_integrity.tracked_data_policy: Never overwrite data/*.tif. The current tracked training_features.tif, labels.tif, and sample_submission.tif differ materially from the verified staging copies; see the preflight evidence.
data_integrity.sample_template_policy: Use staged sample_submission.tif only for grid metadata and finite domain; never use its pixel predictions or labels as features.
data_integrity.forbidden_predictor: dist_known_fault_px in the staged GDR CSV is label-derived; do not read, derive, or use it.

qualifier.deduplicate: One qualifying site per raster row/column; no score-dependent selection.

pre_holdout_coverage_audit.meaning: Descriptive source coverage only; not a holdout result or performance claim.

h58_a.field: F_geo(x) = max_s max(1 - Euclidean_distance(x,s)/5000 metres, 0), over qualified sites, restricted to all-band-valid training footprint.

views.view_a: H57 potential-field/subsurface feature specification in src/gems52/h57.py
views.view_b: H57 surface/DEM and available radiometric/LiDAR feature specification in src/gems52/h57.py
views.training_sample_policy: Both positive and negative samples must be inside fit; negative clearance is derived only from labels visible within fit, never held-region labels.

oof_errors.assignment: Whole 8-connected catalogue components assigned to the majority quadrant.
oof_errors.block_crossing_component_policy: If a component assigned elsewhere intersects the held quadrant, quarantine that entire component from this fold's fit and visible mask; do not add it to this fold's scored truth.
oof_errors.negative_class: Catalogue-zero proxy, not verified geological absence.

pseudo_label_exchange.evaluation_auc_mask: All majority-assigned held components versus catalogue-zero proxy negatives >=500 m from the full catalogue, inside the edge-cleared scored region; the training collar must not remove the scored pixels.
pseudo_label_exchange.pseudo_region: Next quadrant cyclically; outer evaluation quadrant and its 80-pixel buffer excluded.

holdout.whole_components: Original 8-connected catalogue components remain whole and are assigned to the quadrant containing most of their pixels; any component crossing into a scored block from another majority quadrant is quarantined whole from that fold's training/visible mask, but not added to its scored truth.
holdout.prevalence_rule: Per-fold whole-component target is 0.002 times that fold's scored region pixels; hide scores the valid footprint, block scores the quadrant plus 3-pixel kernel halo.
holdout.metric: Official distance-weighted Tversky index, 300 m triangular kernel, alpha=0.2, beta=0.8.
holdout.candidate_field: H58-A F_geo; no learned or prior pixel values.
holdout.block_mode_budget_rule: Scale each global budget by the fold's eligible region share of the all-band-valid footprint; report integer rounding.

emitter.type: isotropic minimum separation aware of the 300 m kernel
emitter.candidate_support_rule: H58-A may emit only at F_geo > 0; never backfill a support shortfall with zero-score cells
emitter.support_shortfall: Fail budget comparability and the registered gate.
